sector_news.title: Indian pharma market grew 13.5% in September 2026 (12-month 10.9%); volume only +2.9%, so growth is coming from price and mix
sector_news.impact: Supports domestic-heavy names (Mankind, Alkem, Ipca, Ajanta). Volume-light growth = pricing & new launches matter more than reach.

statement_impact.doing: Companies outgrowing the market: Ajanta, Ipca, Glenmark.

sector_news.title: US Section 232 100% tariff on patented drugs widens; India gets zero-duty eligibility for select specialty categories; generics excluded
sector_news.impact: Generic exporters (Alembic, Ajanta, Alkem, Glenmark US) largely outside scope. Specialty/branded (Alembic Pivya, Glenmark Ryaltris) need product-level review.

statement_impact.pl: Generics excluded for now; specialty brands may face tariffs.
statement_impact.doing: Indian firms rely on the generics exclusion.
statement_impact.should: Map each company's US product mix by tariff exposure.

sector_news.title: US President signals generics tariff path: 0% for 2 years from Aug-1, then 100%, then 200% for firms not building US plants
sector_news.impact: Medium-term overhang on US-heavy generics (Alembic 36% US, Ajanta 30%, Glenmark 27%, Alkem 20%). Triggers US-footprint / CDMO-partnering strategy questions.

statement_impact.pl: If applied, US margins fall sharply after 2 years unless companies build US plants.
statement_impact.doing: 0% for 2 years gives time to adapt.
statement_impact.should: US footprint options study: contract manufacturing, partner plants, price strategy.

sector_news.title: API, solvent & logistics inflation from Middle-East conflict flagged by Glenmark, Mankind, Alkem, Ipca on Q1 calls
sector_news.impact: Gross-margin pressure expected for 2+ quarters; backward-integrated players (Ipca, Alembic API) relatively insulated.

statement_impact.pl: Material and freight costs up, so gross margin falls.
statement_impact.cf: More cash tied up in stock.
statement_impact.doing: Flagged on Q1 calls; API-integrated firms (Alembic, Ipca) are cushioned.
statement_impact.should: Procurement and price-pass-through programme; dual sourcing.

meta.one_offs: Glenmark FY26 includes AbbVie licensing income; Mankind includes BSV from Oct 2024; Ipca includes Unichem from FY24; Alkem's Daman plant is OAI with the US FDA.
regulatory_takeaways: Approvals ≠ revenue. Alembic has the deepest book (244 approvals, 185 marketed) → ~₹3,100 Cr annualised US revenue (Q1 FY27 ×4); Ajanta earns ~₹1,950 Cr annualised from ~51 products, about 2.3x more revenue per product. Picking products with few competitors beats filing more of them.

Companies spending more on R&D have lower margins today (link strength {rr}): Alembic (9% R&D) and Glenmark (6–7%) carry the heaviest pipelines; the payoff is visible in US growth (Alembic US +49%, Glenmark NA +41% in Q1 FY27) but not yet in margin.

Compliance is a revenue variable. Alkem's Daman OAI (Aug-2026) covers ~45% of its US sales and coincided with a US guidance cut and a 52-week low; Glenmark's Goa warning-letter closeout (Sep-2026) and Monroe VAI remove overhangs ahead of 2–3 respiratory approvals.
Tariff lens. Generics are outside the Sep-2026 Section 232 tariff, but the Jul-2026 proposal (0% → 100% → 200%) makes US-share a strategic-risk KPI: Alembic 36%, Ajanta 30%, Glenmark 27%, Alkem 20%.

Invested heavily (~₹2,000 Cr+) in new oral-solid oncology, injectables, ophthalmic and derma plants at Karkhadi, Panelav and Jarod to move up the complexity curve; entered US branded specialty via Alembic Therapeutics (Pivya, Feb-2026).

footprint.rnd: R&D centres at Vadodara & Hyderabad. Q1 FY27 R&D ₹186 Cr (9% of sales, +29% YoY); FY27 guided ₹750–800 Cr. Focus: peptides, complex generics, specialty.

problems.evidence: ROCE flat at 11–13% for 5 yrs; fixed assets + CWIP ₹3,764 Cr vs ₹7,345 Cr sales (asset turn ~1.9x vs Ajanta ~2.6x).
problems.answer: Plant-loading masterplan: map 35 pending + upcoming ANDAs to Karkhadi/Jarod lines; fill idle capacity with CDMO/third-party contracts (US tariff-driven demand for non-China capacity); line-level OEE program. Target +500 bps ROCE by FY29.

problems.title: Release ₹500 Cr+ trapped in inventory

problems.answer: End-to-end S&OP with US demand sensing (wholesaler 852/EDI data), SKU-tail rationalisation of the 185-product US book, API safety-stock re-optimisation, vendor-managed KSM. Target CCC <300 days in 18 months.
problems.investigate: Inventory split (RM/WIP/FG, US vs India); SKU ABC-XYZ; forecast accuracy; write-off history.
problems.service: Operations: Supply chain & working capital; Finance transformation

problems.title: Close the India branded growth gap (~5% vs IPM ~11%)
problems.evidence: India branded +7% in Q1 FY27, +5% FY26 while IPM grew ~11%; specialty divisions growing double-digit, core divisions lagging.
problems.answer: Sales-force effectiveness diagnostic (PCPM, doctor-call quality, brand-division fit); reallocate MRs to high-growth specialty (gynaec/gastro/ophthal); launch omnichannel HCP engagement; selective in-licensing for chronic.

problems.evidence: US = 36% of revenue; reported +49% vs ex-bosutinib +20–25%; generics tariff path (100%→200%) proposed Jul-2026.
problems.answer: Product-level erosion model & launch-replacement plan; prioritise limited-competition complex filings (injectables, ophthal, peptides); tariff scenario P&L and a US-footprint option (contract manufacturing / partnership) for top-20 SKUs.
problems.investigate: Top-10 product revenue share; competitor entry timelines; tariff exposure by SKU price band.
problems.service: Strategy: Portfolio & scenario planning; Tax & Trade

problems.title: Raise R&D productivity and prove the branded-specialty model
problems.evidence: R&D ₹750–800 Cr (~9% of sales) is the highest intensity in the set yet EBITDA margin is the lowest; Pivya dilutes 100–150 bps.
problems.answer: R&D portfolio triage with risk-adjusted NPV & stage-gates; partner/out-license low-fit assets; Pivya launch-excellence & breakeven tracker (scripts, payer coverage, CAC).
problems.investigate: R&D spend per approval & per ₹ of launch revenue; Pivya weekly TRx; payer access.
